traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Orc Blood
traits.summary: Count as both human and orc for effects related to race.

traits.name: Orc Ferocity
traits.summary: Once per day remain conscious and fighting for 1 round when reduced below 0 hit points.

traits.name: Weapon Familiarity
traits.summary: Gain greataxe and falchion proficiency and treat orc weapons as martial.

alternateTraits.name: Beastmaster
alternateTraits.summary: Treat whip and net as martial weapons and gain +2 Handle Animal.

alternateTraits.name: Chain Fighter
alternateTraits.summary: Gain flail and heavy flail proficiency and treat dire flails and spiked chains as martial.

alternateTraits.name: Gatecrasher
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +2 on Strength checks to break objects and +2 on sunder attempts.

alternateTraits.name: Plagueborn
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +2 on saves against disease, ingested poison, nausea, and sickness.

alternateTraits.name: Sacred Tattoo
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +1 luck on all saving throws.

alternateTraits.name: Scavenger
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +2 Appraise and specified Perception checks for hidden objects, spoiled food, and potions.

alternateTraits.name: Toothy
alternateTraits.summary: Gain a primary bite attack dealing 1d4 piercing damage.
